verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Appwrite's Console or product that a user can hand tasks to. What is documented is an MCP server, skills files, and Markdown docs that let external agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor operate on an Appwrite project. That is integration with third-party agents, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit. A built-in assistant is a plausible feature for a backend platform, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
